statement: A competitive search over a fixed grid of ML and rule strategies on outcome-exposed Korean history. Every number it produces is development evidence. A chronological walk-forward split is NOT independent or prospective validation. Nothing here promotes a selector, changes production, touches a sealed study, a lock or signal-history.
benchmarkBasis: PRIMARY: docs/audits/kr-alpha-atlas-phase-c-integrity/benchmark-reconciliation-corrected.json correctedBenchmarkQuotes (gross ETF market-price total return, ex-date close reinvestment, every year 2013-2026 reconciled within 0.5pp against an independent source: aggregateStatus PASS). SENSITIVITY: replay-v16 069500.KS Close (carries the unexplained accrual recorded in the v2.46/v2.47 concentration audits).
universe: PIT Top120 by monthly KRX market cap, snapshot strictly older than the signal date (kr-alpha-atlas Phase B membership)

features.source: kr_alpha_atlas_matrix.build_matrix at signal-history 4ea107ed (Phase B PIT matrix, 76 catalogue columns), plus benchmark-derived market state and the dated BOK policy rate
features.crossSectionalTransform: company and industry features: within-date percentile rank in (0,1], NaN kept NaN for trees; linear models: rank-0.5 with NaN->0 plus per-layer missing-share indicators. Date-level market features: raw values (trees) / train-only z-score (linear). No transform reads a later date.

featureSets.CIMX: CIM + 6 pre-declared product interactions (linear models only)

labels.entry: close of the first KR session AFTER the signal date (signal uses data through the signal-date close)
labels.target: stock total-return minus 069500.KS total-return over the same entry->exit sessions
labels.maturity: a label is usable for training only if its exit session is strictly before the first signal date of the fold
labels.withheld: a window whose exit session has no finite stock close (terminated / not yet priced) has no label

walkForward.scheme: expanding window, refit once per calendar year
walkForward.purge: labels with exit session >= first signal date of the fold are excluded (equivalent to a full-horizon purge)
walkForward.note: fold 2015 predictions exist only to give 2016 a past-only matured calibration; they never enter the portfolio NAV

portfolio.rebalance: every 4th weekly signal date from the first 2016 signal date
portfolio.economicGate: expected H126 excess of the name's within-date percentile bucket, estimated as the date-equal-weighted mean realised excess of the SAME strategy's past OOS predictions whose labels matured before the decision date, minus a round-trip stock cost and the ETF switch cost; a name enters only if that is > 0
portfolio.suspension: a held name with zero volume or no close is carried at its last close and cannot be traded; a sell is deferred, a buy is skipped (ETF keeps the weight)
portfolio.termination: a held name with no close after its last priced session: primary path values it at ZERO (lower bound, flagged TERMINAL_UNRESOLVED_LOWER_BOUND); a sensitivity path converts it to the ETF at its last close (upper bound). Neither is a measured consideration.
portfolio.concentrationSensitivity: forced top-1 / top-3 / top-5 without the economic gate, reported separately, never ranked as the primary book

rankings.absolute: net CAGR over the common evaluation period
rankings.riskAdjusted: Sharpe ratio of daily net returns over the dated BOK policy-rate proxy
rankings.stability: mean of the within-tournament ranks of: share of calendar years with positive excess vs ETF; min(first-half, second-half) excess CAGR; share of rolling 252-session windows with positive excess; excess CAGR after removing the 5 largest contributing names' contributions

objectiveMap.RANK: lambdarank grouped by signal date on within-date excess quintile (0-4)
rank:pairwise grouped by signal date on within-date excess quintile

RF.missing: NaN -> 0.5 (cross-sectional median rank) for company/industry, train median for market

strategies.FOUR_FACTOR: equal-weight mean of within-date ranks: A07 momentum12-1, B01 book-to-market, C02 ROE, inverse F02 downside vol (production's four sleeves, approximated on PIT inputs)
strategies.INDUSTRY_MOMENTUM: H01_industryRelMom126 then A09 within the industry

RULE.note: rule scores go through the SAME calibration gate and weight policy as every ML model

secondaryH252.configs: every LGBM CIM config and every RIDGE config, with the H252 label; same portfolio rule with H252 calibration
secondaryH252.status: secondary; never mixed into the H126 rankings

overfit: deflated Sharpe ratio with effective trial count

preOutcomeRevisions.foundBy: tests/test_ml_strategy_tournament_v1.py::test_no_name_passes_when_the_past_top_bucket_lost_money, before any model fit or outcome read
preOutcomeRevisions.change: only the three top percentile buckets (>= 0.8) can admit a name; the [0, 0.8) bucket is a reference only
preOutcomeRevisions.reason: as first frozen, a strategy whose top buckets lost money could still hold the best names of the bottom 80% whenever that broad bucket beat the ETF, i.e. it would be credited universe carry rather than its own ranking (alpha attribution invariant v2.7)

preOutcomeRevisions.foundBy: reading the repository's benchmark audits before any model fit or outcome read
preOutcomeRevisions.change: labels, calibration and the ETF sleeve use the reconciled 069500.KS total-return series; the replay-v16 series is a reported sensitivity
preOutcomeRevisions.reason: the replay-v16 ETF series accrues about +4.5%/yr over the price index against +1.85% for a same-data constituent reference (BENCHMARK_EXTERNAL_RECONCILIATION_UNRESOLVED), while the later corrected series passes an independent annual reconciliation
